headline: Week 9: swap the injured A.J. Brown out of your FLEX for Adonai Mitchell, keep Willis at QB, and grab Caleb Douglas or Antonio Williams off waivers.
alerts: A.J. Brown is listed out (knee, ankle) and is in your FLEX. Replace him with Adonai Mitchell before Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific.
Germie Bernard is on bye. Keep him on the bench.
Amon-Ra St. Brown is listed questionable (ankle, head knock in Week 8). Watch Thursday and Friday practice.
Breece Hall is expected back at KC Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Singletary vs Hall depends on Cam Skattebo's hamstring.
Seattle plays at 1:25 PM Pacific Sunday. Vikings host Buffalo Monday 5:15 PM Pacific, with Kyler Murray uncertain.
Trade deadline is Tuesday Nov 10. A Jonathan Taylor trade would boost Seth McGowan.

MIA.note: Hosts Detroit Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Lions -7, total 50.5, Miami about 21.75 implied. De'Von Achane is on IR.

DET.note: At Miami Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Detroit about 28.75 implied. LB Jack Campbell doubtful, S Kerby Joseph out, Branch and Wonnum in concussion protocol.

SEA.note: Hosts Arizona Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific on a short week after Monday night. Seahawks -10.5, total 41.5, about 26 implied.

NYG.note: At Philadelphia Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific, off a bye. Giants -3.5, total 39.5. Skattebo day-to-day (hamstring), Tracy on IR.

PHI.note: Hosts the Giants. Hurts on IR, Tanner McKee starts. Eagles about 18 implied, Barkley banged up.

IND.note: Hosts Dallas Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific, indoors. Cowboys -6, total 51.5. Jonathan Taylor is in trade rumors before the Nov 10 deadline.

NYJ.note: At Kansas City Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific. Chiefs -9.5, total 46.5, Jets about 18.5 implied. Forecast 60F with light wind. Breece Hall expected back.

MIN.note: Hosts Buffalo Monday 5:15 PM Pacific, indoors. Bills -3.5, total about 45.5. Kyler Murray (hamstring) is uncertain, Carson Wentz would start.

GB.note: At New England Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. Patriots -3, total 46.5.

NE.note: Hosts Green Bay Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific. A.J. Brown, Hunter Henry and TreVeyon Henderson are all uncertain.

8161.name: Malik Willis
notes: Healthy and the clear Dolphins starter. Hosts Detroit Sunday 10:00 AM Pacific.
Lions -7, total 50.5, Miami about 21.75 implied. Detroit allows the most fantasy points to QBs and its LB and secondary group is banged up.
Props: 206.5 pass yards, 1.5 pass TDs (under favored), 0.5 INTs, 32.5 rush yards, anytime TD +190. That works out to about 18.1 points.
Rushing floor gives him the edge over Darnold. Sacked often behind a weak line.

4943.name: Sam Darnold
notes: No injury designation. Starting for Seattle, who hosts Arizona Sunday 1:25 PM Pacific on a short week after Monday night.
Seahawks -10.5, total 41.5 and falling, Seattle about 26 implied. A big home favorite may lean on the run.
Props: 226.5 pass yards, 1.5 pass TDs (over favored), 0.5 INTs (under favored), 6.5 rush yards. About 17.0 points.
Close call with Willis, but Willis has the rushing floor and the better game total. Keep Darnold as the QB2.
